chief_complaint: Recent acute non‑ST‑segment elevation myocardial infarction (NSTEMI) with ongoing secondary prevention therapy.
history_of_present_illness: The patient experienced an acute NSTEMI on 2019-09-01, resulting in hospitalization and likely percutaneous coronary intervention. Since that event, he has been placed on guideline‑directed secondary prevention medications (aspirin, prasugrel, high‑intensity atorvastatin, metoprolol succinate, lisinopril). He continues to work full‑time and reports chronic low back pain dating back to 2014, for which he is taking multiple opioid analgesics (tramadol, Percocet, hydrocodone/acetaminophen). Chronic sinusitis has been present since 2008. No follow‑up visits, laboratory values, or vital signs are recorded after the index event.
